messages:
Zoey K: hi everyone, i'm Zoey (frontend) and i'm trying to get set up to validate the onboarding-experiments in staging. who can give me console access for flags + the admin panel for experiment-runner? also want to know how audit logs for flag changes work :wave:
Grant Ops: welcome Zoey! i can grant you staging flag admin and experiment-runner viewer. audit logs are retained in the Console -> Activity -> Flags. do you need write on experiment-runner or just view?
Zoey K: for now view + ability to schedule experiment runs would be ideal. no prod access needed this week.
Riley S: hey @Zoey, congrats! we usually give new joiners a 36h staging admin token and add them to the "onboarding-crew" project for observability. scheduling runs requires the `experiment-scheduler` role. Grant, can you add that?
Grant Ops: yep. i'll provision `flags-admin-staging` + `experiment-scheduler` for 36h. command i use:
```
accessctl grant --user zoey.k --roles flags-admin-staging,experiment-scheduler --ttl 36h --reason "new hire onboarding"
```
Grant Ops: note: scheduling a run will create an audit entry. audit entries show who changed the flag, what percent, and a timestamp. we also link to the rollout ticket if you include the ticket id in the scheduler description.
Zoey K: perfect, thanks. where do i find the Activity logs link? i'm not seeing Console -> Activity yet.
Grant Ops: you should see a new "Activity" tab in the left nav once the role is applied. if not, try a hard refresh or logout/login. i'll check after i run the grant.
Audit-Bot: Access event: grant user=zoey.k roles=flags-admin-staging,experiment-scheduler ttl=36h actor=grant.ops id=evt_1780003333_audit
Riley S: small security reminder: do not flip prod flags without a change ticket and two approvers. for staging experiments, include a short expected metric direction in the scheduler description so reviewers know what to watch.
Zoey K: thanks for the heads up. Grant, any special steps to schedule a run?
Grant Ops: open Experiment Runner -> New Run -> choose "onboarding-experiments" -> set rollout % and schedule. or via API:
```
POST https://console.api.redwood/v1/experiments/run
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral_token>
{
  "experiment": "onboarding-experiments",
  "env": "staging",
  "rollout_pct": 20,
  "starts_at": "2026-04-01T15:00:00Z",
  "notes": "onboarding smoke test: expect +2% signups"
}
```
Grant Ops: use ephemeral tokens (Profile -> API tokens -> ephemeral) for API calls. TTL is capped at 24h by default.
People-Ops: welcome Zoey! if you want a buddy for the first run, reply here and we'll pair you with someone from product. also FYI: onboarding checklist has a section to confirm you saw the audit logs.
Zoey K: i can pair tomorrow morning if Riley or someone is free. i see Activity now and can also view the scheduler UI. thanks all :tada:
Riley S: happy to pair tomorrow 9:30am PT. ping me and i'll join. welcome aboard!
